cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Let Go of the Grudge
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender resentment, distance, or a claim that keeps the relationship stuck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Come sit beside me at dinner. I know you're still angry I missed your opening night.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You left that seat empty. You can have an empty one tonight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I deserved that last night. Could tonight's seat have you in it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm still going to tell you what you missed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please do. Move your plate over; I want to hear every scene.
